result.text:
OPEN PDF STUDIO
Offline OCR Phase A
Total 42.50 EUR
warnings: Detection uses bounded DB-style quadrilateral extraction and deterministic layout ordering.

memory.method: sum of RSS for the MCP app/PDFium process tree plus WebKit XPC processes born while each disposable OCR child is alive, sampled every 50 ms
memory.caveat: OS RSS includes shared and allocator-retained pages. The editor WebView is excluded because launchd reparenting makes its XPC ownership unprovable from process metadata and the isolated OCR path never transfers raster/model bytes into it; parent native allocations, PDFium, the OCR child, and its newly born WebKit cohort are included.

resourceLifetime.classification: WebView allocator retention, bounded by one-job native child process; no cycle-over-cycle process leak observed
resourceLifetime.staleResultVerification: js/ocr/engine.test.mjs removes listeners, empties pending requests, and ignores a saved stale callback after cancellation
resourceLifetime.cancellationNote: Parent-controlled cancellation terminates and reaps the one-job application child, so in-flight ONNX/WASM allocations are reclaimed at the process boundary.

isolation.rationale: Worker termination did not release WebKit allocator pages to the long-lived app process; process exit is the reclamation boundary.

accuracy.normalizedExpected: open pdf studio offline ocr phase a total 42.50 eur
accuracy.normalizedActual: open pdf studio offline ocr phase a total 42.50 eur

offline.limitation: Every Worker fetch is mechanically restricted to its application origin and vendored assets are checksum-verified; this run did not disable the host network interface.

viewerResponsiveness.method: MCP round-trip timing for awaited viewer zoom renders and viewport probes while a separate isolated OCR request is in flight
viewerResponsiveness.acceptanceNote: No approved viewer-latency threshold was provided; raw baseline and concurrent timings are reported without inventing one.

gate.crossPlatformProductionDecision: Windows and Linux live runs still required
